staff_reports.title: Rezone Petition - 7306 Springfield Ave - Staff Report
staff_reports.summary: Staff analysis finds the rezone is consistent with the Comprehensive Plan and neighboring B-G properties. The property's unique shape and size make other commercial use or redevelopment unlikely.
staff_reports.suggested_motion: To recommend to the Mayor and Town Council that the zoning of 7306 Springfield Ave be changed from Business Local (B-L) to Business General (B-G).

staff_reports.title: Site Plan - 7503 Village Rd (Rob's Barber Shop) - Staff Report

application.title: Site Plan - 7503 Village Rd (Rob's Barber Shop)

staff_reports.summary: The property is zoned Business-Local which allows for the proposed use of a barber shop as a principal permitted use. The site has existed with the same layout since the early 1980s and has functioned primarily as a convenience store.
staff_reports.suggested_motion: To approve the proposed site plan and to allow a modification of the minimum parking space size requirements in order to accommodate the 9 ft by 17.5 ft parking spaces shown on the plan along the perimeter of the parking lot.
